product.name: Baggy Jeans
product.description: 5-pocket jeans in non-stretch cotton denim for denim perfection. Rounded legs and baggy fit from seat to hem with plenty of room around legs. Regular waist, zip fly, and dropped gusset. Stacked at ankle.
